description: A shooting during the East End Day gathering at Charles Young Park in Lexington on August 15 killed sixteen-year-old Di'Zhon Robertson and wounded four people, including children. Police responded shortly before 7 p.m. local time.

title: Historic flooding in Indiana kills seven
description: Days of severe storms and record-setting rainfall produced historic flooding across Indiana, killing at least seven people by August 16, with the White River cresting at record levels and the National Guard assisting rescues. Dozens of people were rescued from vehicles and homes as rivers overflowed across the state.

review.note: Seven is a cumulative storm/flood-related toll reported August 16, not seven deaths necessarily occurring that day. NWS places the rainfall/flood episode earlier in the week. This overlaps the August 12 Midwest three-death record, which already includes Indiana victims. Resolve incident boundaries, direct/indirect deaths and duplicate victims before publication.

title: Landslide hits apartment in Geoje, South Korea, killing one
location: Okpo-dong, Geoje, South Gyeongsang, South Korea
description: A rain-triggered landslide struck a ground-floor apartment in Okpo-dong, Geoje, early on August 17 local time. Three people were rescued; one subsequently died. The other two survived.

title: Russian attack on Kryvyi Rih kills two
description: An overnight Russian missile and drone attack on Kryvyi Rih damaged industrial facilities. Regional authorities later reported two people killed and fourteen injured after another body was recovered on the morning of August 16.

review.note: Later regional reporting updates one dead/six injured to two dead/fourteen injured. The 04:25 time is a casualty update, not necessarily the strike time. August 15 versus 16 UTC remains unresolved for the overnight attack.

title: Ukrainian attacks across Russia reportedly kill six
location: Moscow region and other areas, Russia
description: Russian authorities reported at least six deaths after widespread overnight Ukrainian drone attacks reported August 16. Attacks affected the Moscow region and other areas, including industrial and energy facilities.

review.note: The six reported deaths and Russian claims of hundreds of drones are supported, but this is an overnight multi-region aggregate without UTC incident times. Do not infer occurrence date from the August 16 release or independently validate the claimed interception count/ranking. Resolve the fatal incidents before publishing a single-date total.

title: Wildfires on Salamina kill two
description: An elderly couple died during wildfires on Salamina on August 16. Fires broke out around midday in Peristeria and Selinia, prompting evacuations, including hundreds of people taken off the island by sea.

title: Pickup-truck collision on Gwalior-Bhind highway kills eight labourers
description: A pickup carrying migrant labourers collided with a dumper truck near Chhimka in Bhind district around 01:00 local time on August 18. Eight people were killed and numerous others injured.

title: Russian drone strike on Dniprovska mine near Pavlohrad kills one worker
location: Bohdanivske, Pavlohrad district, Dnipropetrovsk region, Ukraine
description: Russian drones struck the Dniprovska mine in the Bohdanivske community of Dnipropetrovsk region on August 17, killing one employee and injuring another, according to DTEK and local reporting.

title: School shooting in Zamboanga City leaves two dead, including attacker
description: A student shot another student and then himself at Ateneo de Zamboanga University's junior high school campus in Zamboanga City on the morning of August 18 local time. Police and the university confirmed two deaths, including the attacker.

title: Ukrainian missile strikes on Koloskovo in Belgorod region kill six
location: Koloskovo, Valuysky district, Belgorod region, Russia
description: Russian regional authorities reported that a Ukrainian missile attack on Koloskovo in Belgorod region killed six people and injured four, including a child. The announcement was made on August 17; the precise UTC date of the attack remains unestablished.

review.note: The August 17 morning announcement supports six reported deaths and four injuries but does not establish whether the strike was before or after midnight UTC. Border distance is 15 miles, about 24 km, not 15 km. Short proposed prose removes the unsupported distance and burning detail; date remains unresolved.

title: Gold mine collapse on Cameroon-CAR border kills over 100 miners
description: An artisanal gold mine collapsed at Zamboye near the Cameroon border on August 18. Local reporting attributed 107 recovered bodies to Garoua-Boulai's mayor; AP reported more than 100 deaths, while CAR authorities said the exact toll was still being established.

review.note: CAR authorities locate the mine in their territory; some initial Cameroonian reports mislocate it. The 107 figure is the Garoua-Boulai mayor's provisional recovery account, not a final CAR-confirmed count. CAR prosecutors said the exact total was still being determined. Retain that contradiction explicitly; final toll is unresolved.

title: Israeli airstrike on cafe near Gaza Port kills six
description: An Israeli strike hit a crowded seaside cafe near Gaza City's fishing port on August 18, killing six Palestinians, including a child, according to medical and eyewitness reports.

title: Russian missile strike on Pechenihy in Kharkiv region kills ten
description: A Russian missile strike hit the centre of Pechenihy in Kharkiv region on the morning of August 18, killing ten people, Ukrainian officials said. Shops, a post office and residential buildings were damaged, and numerous people were injured.

title: Fire in commercial building in Qinhuangdao kills eight
description: A fire broke out in a ground-floor commercial property in Haigang district, Qinhuangdao, at about 03:40 local time on August 20. Eight people were killed and three injured. The fire was extinguished and its cause was under investigation.

title: Torrential rains in southwest China kill ten
description: Torrential rains across southwest China killed 10 people and forced thousands to evacuate, with flooding and landslides reported across the region. Officials warned that disaster risk remained high as further heavy rainfall was forecast, and emergency response teams were deployed to affected areas.

review.note: August 19 is publication date. Ten combines five in a Guangxi construction-site landslide on Monday August 17 and five in a Changning, Sichuan banquet-wall collapse at 17:30 CST August 18. This is not one August 19 incident. Preserve the aggregate in audit; split/reconcile actual incidents before publication. The Guangxi incident's precise UTC timing remains unestablished.

title: Charter plane crash in western Alaska kills all eight on board
description: A charter aircraft crashed near a remote radar facility in western Alaska on August 20, 2026, killing all eight people on board. The US Air Force confirmed there were no survivors, and rescue teams faced difficult access to the crash site.

title: Gang attack on Kenscoff in Haiti kills at least 47
description: Armed gangs attacked Kenscoff late on August 23 local time, killing residents, burning homes and attacking a church sheltering displaced people. AP reported at least 47 deaths by August 30. The final incident-specific toll remained uncertain.

title: Montana man kills eight relatives and himself at family dinner
description: A man killed eight relatives, including four children, at a family home outside Billings on Sunday evening, August 23 local time, before dying by suicide. Police responded shortly after 18:00, and the house caught fire. Nine people died, including the attacker.

title: Ice-rock avalanche triggers Nepal-Tibet flood killing at least 1,446
location: Bhote Koshi valley, Rasuwagadhi, Nepal / Tibet border
description: An ice-rock avalanche near the Nepal-Tibet border triggered a destructive flood through the Bhote Koshi and Trishuli river corridors on August 26. Reporting by September 17 put recovered deaths at 1,403 in Nepal and 43 in China, a combined 1,446. Another 6,669 people were reported missing across both countries, separately from the death toll. Scientific analysis indicated warming likely contributed to slope instability.

title: Church minibus collision in central Zimbabwe kills 27
description: A minibus carrying church members collided head-on with a truck that was overtaking in central Zimbabwe on August 28, 2026, killing at least 27 people. Police reported the crash on Saturday, August 29, in the latest deadly road accident to hit the country.

title: Israeli strikes kill five in Gaza and three in West Bank
location: Gaza Strip and West Bank, Palestine
description: Israeli airstrikes on August 28, 2026 killed five people in Gaza and three in the West Bank city of Jenin, according to Palestinian health officials. The strikes came amid continuing Israeli military operations despite the ceasefire framework, as tensions persisted across the occupied territories.

title: Russian drone strike on ammunition warehouse near Kyiv kills 38
location: Myla, Bucha district, Kyiv region, Ukraine
description: A Russian drone strike hit an ammunition storage site in Myla on the evening of August 28, triggering explosions and fires in nearby buildings. President Zelenskyy reported 38 deaths and 20 injuries on August 30, with four people still missing. Authorities opened an inquiry into the storage arrangements.

title: Israeli strikes kill at least five across the Gaza Strip
description: Israeli attacks across the Gaza Strip on August 31, 2026, killed at least five people, according to Palestinian health officials. The strikes hit several parts of the enclave amid the continuing Israel-Hamas war.

title: Suspected PDF fighters kill 12 civilians in Mahlaing Township, Myanmar
description: Twelve civilians were killed in an attack on Hta Man Gyi village in Mahlaing Township, Mandalay Region, on August 31, 2026, which Myanmar's military government blamed on members of the resistance-aligned People's Defence Force. State media said the attackers entered the village and opened fire on residents.

review.note: Approximately 04:00 MMT August 31 is August 30 UTC. ACLED describes an unidentified armed group and victims including administrators/security-team or militia leaders assumed unarmed; military media blame PDF. Do not silently endorse either perpetrator identity or civilian status. IOM URL is a country feed, not a stable individual source record; Myawady open failed although search retrieved its text. Corroboration and victim status remain insufficient for publication.

title: Russian missile and drone attacks on Kyiv kill at least 12
description: Russian missile and drone attacks on Kyiv and surrounding areas on September 1, 2026, killed at least 12 people, including an Indian national, and wounded dozens more, according to Ukrainian officials. Residential buildings and other civilian infrastructure were damaged in what President Volodymyr Zelenskyy described as a continuing series of Russian strikes on the capital.

review.note: Twelve deaths including an Indian national are supported, but the attack ran more than 12 hours overnight August 31-September 1 and into Tuesday. Fatal incident times were not established sufficiently to assign all twelve to September 1 UTC. The publication date cannot resolve the mixed interval.

title: US airstrike on wedding party in Hormozgan province kills five
description: A US strike hit a home hosting a wedding celebration in Kuhestak on the evening of September 1, according to Iranian authorities and AP's subsequent on-scene reporting. Five people died, including a woman who died in hospital September 3, and more than 60 were injured. Vice President JD Vance said September 3 that the US was investigating.

title: US strike reportedly kills four IRGC members in Kermanshah
description: Iran's provincial IRGC reported four Aerospace Force members killed in a US strike in Kermanshah, according to September 2 reporting. The precise UTC date remains unestablished; the casualty claim came from Iranian authorities, not CENTCOM.

review.note: CENTCOM confirms operations, not five Kermanshah deaths. Anadolu September 2 attributes FOUR Aerospace Force deaths to the provincial IRGC, separately three Basij on Lavan Island. No corroborated five-person Kermanshah total found. The exact Kermanshah strike time/date within the September 1-2 attacks is not established. Do not merge wedding casualties or Lavan deaths.

title: Bus crash in South Sinai, Egypt, kills at least 22
description: A bus crashed in South Sinai, Egypt, on September 2, 2026, killing at least 22 people, including ten Jordanian nationals, and injuring 28 others. The bus was travelling between the Red Sea towns of Dahab and Nuweiba when the accident occurred.

title: Fuel siphoning deaths in Rivers State, Nigeria, reach 43
description: Dozens of people reportedly died during an alleged petroleum-siphoning attempt at Okari Jetty, Okrika, around midnight at the start of September 3 local time. Reports describe toxic-fume exposure and some drownings, but differ between at least 37 deaths and 43 dead or feared dead.

review.note: Channels gives approximately 00:00 WAT September 3, which is September 2 UTC. Anadolu reports 43 dead but Vanguard calls 43 feared dead and later AP reports at least 37. Reports also differ on loading vessel versus tapped pipeline; some victims reportedly drowned after inhalation. No reconciled confirmed 43-person toll retrieved.

title: Minivan collision on Sege highway in Ghana kills 13
description: A collision involving two passenger minivans on the Sege section of the Accra-Aflao highway killed 13 people on September 2. Others were injured, according to Ghanaian news reports quoting emergency personnel.

title: Minneapolis apartment shooting leaves three dead, including attacker
description: A gunman killed two people at an apartment building in Minneapolis's Loring Park neighborhood on September 2 before police shot and killed him. Three civilians and three officers were injured; two of the officers suffered gunshot wounds.

title: Explosion at military base in Viacha, Bolivia, kills nine
description: Explosions struck the Bolivar military regiment in Viacha on the afternoon of September 4. Authorities confirmed nine deaths by September 8, with five people still missing, and later reported 84 injured. The cause remained under investigation.

title: Fire at wedding party in Kinshasa kills at least 12
location: Lingwala, Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo
description: A fire broke out during a wedding reception at the Panacee hall in Lingwala, Kinshasa, on the evening of September 4. The government's subsequent official account reported 12 deaths, lower than initial local estimates of 22. Investigators were still determining the cause.

title: Mudslide in Mingkeng village, Jiangxi, kills 13
location: Mingkeng village, Suichuan County, Jiangxi, China
description: A mudslide struck Mingkeng village in Gaoping, Suichuan County, around 04:00 local time on September 5 after prolonged rain associated with Typhoon Saudel. Thirteen people died in this mudslide. The separate countywide total of 16 included deaths in two other towns.

title: Pakistani security forces kill 48 separatists in Balochistan raids
description: Pakistan's military announced September 4 that its forces had killed 48 alleged militants during several raids in Balochistan over the preceding 72 hours. This is an attributed operational aggregate, not a September 4 single-day death toll.

review.note: The military's 48 is a multi-raid total over 72 hours ending September 4, not 48 deaths on that date. Geo identifies six in Mastung September 4, with other operations on earlier dates. Incident-specific dates/UTC and allocation are needed before publication as daily events; reporting does not independently establish military claims about all victims.

title: Bus crash on Fogo island, Cape Verde, kills at least 25
description: A passenger bus left a mountain road between Cha das Caldeiras and Campanas de Cima on Fogo island late on September 5, killing 25 people and injuring 14. Many victims were children and adolescents.

title: Fuel tanker explosion on Hamedan-Sanandaj highway, Iran, kills 11
description: A fuel tanker suffered an apparent brake failure, hit other vehicles and exploded on the Hamedan-Sanandaj highway in western Iran on September 5, 2026, killing 11 people and injuring seven others. The initial reported toll of 10 was later revised upward.

title: Avalanche on Mount Mizhirgi, Russia, kills 17 climbers
description: An avalanche hit a group of 33 climbers on Mount Mizhirgi in the Bezengi Gorge on September 6. Search teams recovered the final missing person on September 13, bringing the death toll to 17. Sixteen survived, including six who were hospitalized.

title: Cargo plane crash at Miami airport kills five
description: A Boeing 767-300 cargo plane operated by 21 Air for Amazon Air overshot the runway and struck vehicles while landing at Miami International Airport on September 6, 2026, killing five people and injuring five others.

title: Fireworks explosion at religious celebration in Temascalcingo, Mexico, kills 10
description: Fireworks exploded beside the Nuestra Senora de la Luz church in Santa Maria Canchesda, Temascalcingo, during a religious celebration on the night of September 5 local time. Ten people were killed and 64 injured. The cause was under investigation.

title: Hostel building collapse in New Delhi kills seven
description: A five-storey building housing a private hostel collapsed in Satya Niketan on the afternoon of September 6. The death toll reached seven by September 7, and twelve people were rescued and taken to hospital.

title: Israeli strikes on Kfar Rumman kill 13, including children and a medic
description: Israeli strikes on a residential building and a vehicle in Kfar Rumman were reported on September 7. Lebanon's Health Ministry later reported 13 deaths: twelve in the building, including six children, and one medic in the vehicle strike. Two other medics were wounded. The precise UTC date remains unestablished.

review.note: Al-Monitor September 14 is republication: Reuters dateline/photo September 7; MarketScreener explicitly shows September 7 publication and September 14 modification. NOT a new September 14 attack. Updated ministry toll 13 comprises 12 in building, including 6 children/3 women, plus ONE medic killed and 2 medics wounded; original two-medic-death wording is superseded. Earlier AP 12 and WAFA 11 are preliminary. Reuters contains contradictory timing cues: state media 'after midnight' versus witnesses preparing for school; exact UTC date September 6/7 remains unresolved. Two Reuters URLs share one wire report.

title: Saudi airstrike on prison in Al-Jawf, Yemen, kills 17
description: A Saudi airstrike hit a prison in Al-Jawf Governorate, Yemen, on September 7, 2026, during an offensive against Houthi forces, killing seven people, including a child, and trapping dozens under the rubble. The toll rose to 17 the following day as bodies were recovered.

review.note: AP September 9 reports 23 recovered deaths, superseding 17; these are updates to the September 7 prison incident. Houthi authorities blame Saudi-led airstrikes; the Yemeni rights centre blames the Houthis. Do not state Saudi responsibility as undisputed. Exact strike time/UTC boundary was not established. Two AP documents share publisher and Houthi-source provenance.

sources.name: Yemeni Center for Rehabilitation of Victims of Violations and Torture

title: AFP sources report more than 500 deaths in renewed Yemen fighting
description: AFP reported on September 8 that military and medical sources counted at least 278 Houthi fighters,216 government troops and 29 civilians killed since renewed fighting began the previous week. Their components total 523; this is a cumulative attributed figure, not a single-day toll.

review.note: Components 278+216+29 equal 523, not 500. AFP says MORE THAN 500 and attributes figures to unnamed military/medical sources, not a universally confirmed total. Multi-day offensive since the previous week; September 8 is report date, not date of 523 deaths. Reconcile possible overlap with Al-Jawf prison and other Yemen strikes before integration. Arabic liveblog repeats AFP rather than independently verifies counts.

title: Drone strike near courthouse in Umm Ruwaba, Sudan, kills 13
description: A drone strike near the Um Rawaba courthouse on the afternoon of September 8 killed at least 12 people, according to local reports; the Sudan Doctors Network reported 13. Sources blamed the RSF. The precise toll remains unreconciled.

review.note: Tuesday afternoon September 8 supports same UTC date. Sudan Doctors Network reporting gives 13 dead/22 injured; Radio Tamazuj's authorities/eyewitnesses give 12 dead/20 injured outside courthouse. No reconciled final count retrieved. RSF attribution is a claim by monitoring groups/army-aligned authorities, not independently proven here.

title: Famine in Jebel Marra, Sudan, kills at least 20
description: On September 8, the SLM-AW-aligned civil administration reported famine conditions in Jebel Marra and nearby areas, estimating that up to 20 people were dying daily from hunger and disease. This was a reported mortality estimate, not a verified September 8 event toll.

review.note: Source says UP TO 20 dying EACH DAY from hunger/disease, an estimated mortality rate attributed to SLM-AW-aligned civil administration, not at least 20 identified deaths on September 8. Famine language is a local authority claim, not an IPC determination established here. No incident-level toll/date or second independent source record retrieved.

title: Helicopter crash in Sarawak, Malaysia, kills five
description: A MBB Bo 105 helicopter operated for the Flying Doctors of Malaysia crashed near Long Lellang in Sarawak, Malaysian Borneo, on September 8, 2026, killing all five people on board.

title: Landslide at forest-road work site in Shizuoka kills one worker
description: A landslide at a forest-road construction site in Kawanehoncho trapped a male worker on the morning of September 8. He was transported from the site the next day and confirmed dead.

title: Russian strikes on Kyiv and Kyiv region kill seven
description: Russian strikes reported overnight and during September 8 killed five people in Kyiv and two in the surrounding region, according to Ukrainian authorities. The attacks damaged warehouses and other civilian buildings. Fatal incident times remain insufficiently resolved for a single UTC date.

review.note: City government confirms five killed in September 8 attacks; UATV separately reports two in Kyiv region. Injury counts differ 23/29/35 and need not be retained. Strikes spanned Monday night and Tuesday; exact fatal-incident UTC dates unestablished. Sept 10 two-death Kyiv record may be an earlier bulletin from this attack; do not add without resolving identity.

title: Explosion at Ritom hydroelectric plant in Switzerland kills two workers
description: Two workers died after a fire and explosion at the old Ritom hydroelectric plant in Piotta, Ticino, shortly after 09:30 local time on September 9. Cantonal police described a serious workplace accident.

title: Explosion at weapons depot in Sarmada, Syria, kills 14
description: An explosion at a temporary depot for weapons and war remnants near Sarmada, Idlib, on September 9 killed 14 people and injured 11, according to the local health department's updated account.

title: Israeli strike kills family of four in northern Gaza
description: An Israeli airstrike hit the Ahmed family's home near Kamal Adwan Hospital in northern Gaza at about 01:45 local time on 10 September 2026, or late 9 September UTC. Two parents and their two daughters were killed, according to Palestinian medical and human-rights reporting.

title: Russian drone strike on shopping centre in Sumy kills two
description: A Russian drone hit the parking area of the Manufactura shopping centre in Sumy on the evening of 9 September 2026, killing two people. An initial report of three deaths was corrected. Subsequent reporting put the number injured at 23.

title: Cargo ship fire at Qingdao port kills 25
description: A fire broke out aboard a foreign-flagged cargo ship at a port in Qingdao, Shandong province, eastern China, on September 10, 2026. The death toll rose to 25 during the day as rescue and recovery operations continued aboard the vessel; authorities did not immediately announce a cause.

title: Church roof collapse in Vellore, India, kills three
location: Manju Krishnapuram, Thiruvalam, Vellore district, Tamil Nadu, India
description: The roof of the under-construction CSI Zion Hill Church at Manjukrishnapuram near Thiruvalam in Vellore district collapsed during concreting at about 16:30 local time on 10 September 2026. Three workers were killed and 14 others were injured.

title: Grenade attack on house in Dehiwala, Sri Lanka, kills two children
description: A grenade attack on a house in Dehiwala killed two brothers aged 11 and 17 and injured their father at about 03:20 local time on 11 September 2026, or late 10 September UTC. Police said the attackers appeared to have targeted the wrong house in suspected gang retaliation.

title: Hurricane Lowell linked to at least two deaths in Hawaii
description: Two deaths were linked to Hurricane Lowell in Hawaii: a man killed by a falling tree on Oahu and a man found dead on Kauai after being reported missing. The reports concern different incident and recovery dates, not two established deaths on 10 September.

review.note: Two deaths were linked to the storm, but September 10 is a report/update date. Hawaii News Now places the fatal Waimanalo tree incident at about 20:35 HST on Monday September 7, which is September 8 UTC. The other man's body was recovered on Kauai on September 9 after he went missing the previous day; recovery time does not establish death time. A single September 10 UTC casualty allocation is unsupported. Storm-surge attribution for the Kauai death was preliminary.

title: Russian attacks on Mykolaiv kill four
description: Russian attacks on Mykolaiv during 9 September and the following night killed four people and injured 19, according to Ukrainian police. The figure covers a reporting interval rather than a single established UTC day.

review.note: Four deaths and 19 injuries are supported for attacks during September 9 and the night into September 10, not four established deaths on September 10 UTC. Ukrinform identifies two women and two men among the dead. The reporting interval crosses dates and individual fatal incident times were not established. The first two documents draw on the same police casualty account.

title: Russian large-scale attack on Kyiv kills two
description: A large-scale Russian attack on Kyiv on September 10, 2026, killed two people and injured at least ten, according to Ukrainian authorities.

review.note: Matching two-dead/ten-injured Ukrinform bulletin is dated September 8, not 10; AFP corroborates early September 8 two-death count. September 10 reporting describes a gas-station strike with injuries and a separate regional death, not the claimed city toll. Likely a misdated preliminary duplicate of September 8 aggregate, but cannot assert identical victims without further evidence; do not publish or add twice.

title: Tour bus crash in eastern Switzerland kills five
description: A Dutch tour bus crashed between Zernez and Susch in the Swiss canton of Graubunden at about 16:45 local time on 10 September 2026. Police reported five deaths and 40 injuries among the 44 adult passengers and driver.

title: US strike on suspected drug boat in the Caribbean kills three
description: U.S. Southern Command said its forces killed three people in a strike on a boat in the Caribbean on 9 September 2026. The military alleged that the vessel was involved in drug trafficking; the retrieved reports did not independently establish that allegation.

review.note: SOUTHCOM dates the operation to September 9; September 10 is the reporting date. Both publishers relay the same military announcement, not independent confirmation of the occupants' identities or trafficking allegations. The operation's exact time and the command's date time zone were not established, so the proposed September 9 date is not verified as UTC and the row remains withheld.

title: Ukrainian drone strike kills woman in Borisoglebsk, Russia
description: Regional authorities said an attack by Ukrainian drones overnight on 9-10 September killed a woman and injured two people in Borisoglebsk, Voronezh Oblast.

review.note: Regional authorities reported a woman killed and two people injured in Borisoglebsk. The attack occurred overnight September 9-10 local time; the morning September 10 announcement is not an incident timestamp. Both sources rely on the regional governor. The UTC date remains unresolved, and attribution to Ukraine is the authorities' account.

title: Drone attacks on cars in Kramatorsk
description: Three people were killed in separate drone attacks on cars in Kramatorsk, according to local authorities. The city council reported three incidents within about 90 minutes.

title: N1 minibus collision in Western Cape
location: Between Leeu Gamka and Prince Albert, Western Cape, South Africa
description: A collision involving two minibuses and an SUV killed at least 21 people, according to Western Cape officials. Three of the reported victims died after being taken to hospital.

title: Drone strike on passenger bus in Nikopol district
description: A drone strike on a passenger bus killed five people, according to regional authorities, who attributed the attack to Russian forces.

title: Fatal flooding near Newcomb on the Navajo Nation
location: Newcomb and Two Grey Hills area, New Mexico, United States
description: Two adults and a child died in flooding on the Navajo Nation. Police said their bodies were found near the Newcomb and Two Grey Hills area following overnight flooding.

title: News helicopter crash in Chatsworth
location: Chatsworth, Los Angeles, California, United States
description: A television news helicopter crashed while covering a nearby traffic collision. Two people aboard the aircraft and one person on the ground were killed.

title: SUV and Metro bus collision in Chatsworth
location: Chatsworth, Los Angeles, California, United States
description: Two people died and six others were injured when an SUV collided with a Metro bus, according to the Los Angeles Fire Department.

title: Fatal debris from drone interception near Taif
description: Saudi civil defence said debris from an intercepted drone killed a Yemeni resident and injured two other people. Saudi authorities attributed the drone launch to Yemen's Houthis.

title: Bombing and gun attack on police headquarters in Kohat
description: A bombing and gun attack on a police compound killed at least 31 people, according to the victim toll reported by authorities on September 19. The attack began the previous afternoon.

title: Fatal strike in Jabalia
description: A strike in Jabalia killed one person, according to Palestinian medical sources. This entry records only the Jabalia death, not the larger daily Gaza toll.

title: Fatal strike in Shuja'iyya
description: A strike in Shuja'iyya killed one person, according to Palestinian medical sources. This entry excludes other deaths reported elsewhere in Gaza that day.

title: Fatal shooting near Neve Tzuf
location: Near Neve Tzuf, occupied West Bank
description: A Palestinian gunman shot dead an Israeli man near Neve Tzuf, according to Israeli authorities. The suspect was subsequently detained.

title: Palestinian motorist killed near Ganim
location: Near Ganim, Jenin area, occupied West Bank
description: Israeli troops shot dead a Palestinian motorist. The Israeli military alleged an attempted vehicle attack; Reuters said it could not independently verify the circumstances.

title: Reported airstrike on displacement camp in Kunar
description: Afghan provincial officials said an airstrike killed three people at a camp for families displaced by an earthquake. They attributed the strike to Pakistan; Pakistan's military had not commented in the cited initial report.
